name: Religion In Egypt
overview: Scripture reveals that the religion of Egypt is characterized by idolatry, as the LORD Himself will come into Egypt causing the idols to be shaken and the hearts of the people to melt (Isaiah 19:1). God's redemptive plan includes calling His people out of Egypt, demonstrating His sovereign authority over that land and its false gods (Hosea 11:1). True religion, in contrast to vain or empty practices, is defined by pure devotion to God shown through caring for the vulnerable and maintaining personal holiness (James 1:26-27). This contrast highlights the futility of Egypt's idolatrous religion and calls believers to a Christ-centered faith marked by genuine obedience and compassion.
